question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"fragrant."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage, the blank 1 will describe the quality of the flower named "gardenia."
 
• Now, **among the given options, the word that matches the quality of flower is "fragrant."**(सुगंधित)
 
• Fragrant means having a pleasant or sweet smell.
 
• The word is often used to describe flowers, perfumes, and other pleasant scents.
 
 
• Example: The fragrant aroma of freshly baked bread filled the room.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, soluble, means capable of being dissolved in a liquid.(घुलनशील)
 
• Option 3, stenchy, is not a recognized word in English. The correct form would be stinky, which means having a strong and unpleasant smell.(बदबूदार)
 
• Option 4, polluted, means contaminated or dirtied by harmful substances.(प्रदूषित)
